purpose: Shows brief non-interactive contextual help on hover or focus.

notes: Provider language and direction are applied to the overlay.

useWhen: A focusable control needs a short explanatory hint.
An icon-only action benefits from a visible text label on hover or focus.

avoidWhen.situation: The floating content contains controls or links.
avoidWhen.guidance: Tooltips must remain non-interactive; use a popover.

avoidWhen.situation: Information is essential to completing the task.
avoidWhen.guidance: Place essential guidance visibly in the page.

supportedInteractions: Open from trigger hover or keyboard focus.
Flip or position around the trigger.
approvedPatterns: Wrap one focusable trigger and Tooltip in Tooltip Trigger.
Use the small size for short hints.
Use the large size for wider multiline guidance.
Use start and end placements for direction-aware alignment.
limitations: Tooltip content must not be interactive.
Only the large size renders an arrow.
Pass tone only with size=lg (primary by default or secondary); small and default-size tooltips have one neutral treatment and accept no tone.
accessibility: Use a focusable trigger so keyboard users can reveal the tooltip.
Do not use the tooltip as the only accessible name for an icon-only control.
responsive: Large tooltips have a capped width and can wrap.
Allow flipping when the preferred placement lacks space.
rtl: Provider direction is applied to the tooltip.
Prefer start and end placements when alignment should mirror.
